name: Lorenzo Cardoni
headline: I build computer vision and LLM systems that hold up outside the notebook.
intro: AI Engineer with a background in automation and embedded systems. I work across the whole path of a model: data, training, and deployment on the hardware or in the business process where it has to run.

status.label: Now

about: I studied Computer and Automation Engineering at Università Politecnica delle Marche, where control theory, microcontrollers and machine learning shared the same timetable. That mix still shapes how I work: I care about the model, and just as much about the sensor feeding it and the device running it.

Today I work at Inim Electronics on R&D for computer vision products and on LLM-based automation of business processes. Before that I built data pipelines and an enterprise LLM integration at Lega del Filo d'Oro, and spent my thesis injecting faults into a drone flight controller to train models that detect them.

focus.title: Computer vision and edge AI
focus.text: Object detection with the YOLO family, small-object detection, and models sized for constrained devices such as Jetson boards and STM32 microcontrollers.

focus.title: LLM applications
focus.text: Enterprise chatbots, multimodal LLM workflows and assistants connected to business data, built to automate real processes rather than demo well.

focus.title: Data and embedded systems
focus.text: ETL pipelines in Python and SQL, plus the control and firmware side: MATLAB, Simulink, C/C++ and hardware-in-the-loop testing.
